prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1030; do not mention it.)
text: The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the vehicle was struck from behind while the patient was turning left. Reported symptoms included low back pain with radiation into the right paraspinal region, muscle guarding, and reduced lumbar range of motion, particularly with flexion and rotation. Neurological examination was within normal limits, with intact strength, sensation, and reflexes in both lower extremities. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation given the absence of red-flag findings. Diagnosis was acute lumbar strain without evidence of radiculopathy. Treatment consisted of a structured course of ten outpatient physical therapy visits, including manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, graded core stabilization exercises, and a home exercise program. The patient was also advised on activity modification and the use of over-the-counter analgesics as needed. Progress was steady, with gradual improvement in pain intensity and functional tolerance for sitting, lifting, and prolonged standing. At discharge, lumbar range of motion was near baseline and the patient was independent with the home program. Prognosis for full recovery is good, with return to usual activities expected within several weeks.
